text:
Jamal Ortiz: Canary alert: we saw per-tenant token usage creep after a batch of client reconnects during an edge network flake. Looks like session fencing failed and both old and new sockets were billed.
Priya Nair: Repro steps?
Jamal Ortiz: Steps: open SSE stream -> simulate proxy half-close (netem drop/FIN) -> client reconnects -> new accept completes quickly. Old session keeps counting for ~20-40s. Console shows two 'active inferred sessions' for same resume id.
Felix Müller: Do we have logs showing dual-ownership?
Jamal Ortiz: Snippet from accept logs:
```
INFO 2027-07-12T14:01:07Z accept resume=rs_f7 shard=eu-central1 claim_nonce=0x9b3 last_seen=162240
INFO 2027-07-12T14:01:07Z accept resume=rs_f7 shard=eu-west3 claim_nonce=0x4d1 last_seen=162241
```
Hannah Lee: That indicates two shards accepted. Our existing lease/tombstone was supposed to prevent this but races happen when proxy half-close hides the EOF.
Priya Nair: UX impact: ops sees tenant cost rising and sometimes pages. Short-term mitigation idea: console "slow-mode" for streaming routes where aggregation dedupes by (tenant,resume_id) over a 45s sliding window and surfaces a small banner: "Session fencing reconciliation in progress". Non-destructive (raw numbers available via advanced toggle).
Felix Müller: Backend fixes: a) Make accept call a fast opt-accept + enqueue a claim to a new claim-broker service that does atomic fencing across shards; b) claim-broker does CAS in metadata and emits a compaction event if duplicate accepted; c) billing compaction pipeline consumes compaction events to correct counters.
Jamal Ortiz: Claim-broker sounds good but we're worried about extra round-trip on the hot path. So opt-accept + async claim is preferred. If claim-broker reports conflict, it should emit a compact_ticket with fields {tenant,resume_id,delta_seconds,winner_nonce,loser_nonce}.
Hannah Lee: Add telemetry: metric stream.claim_fence_conflict{shard,tenant,route} and stream.billing_compaction_emitted. Also add tracing spans so the compensating delta is correlated to original accept span.
Priya Nair: Console changes: the slow-mode dedupe should be behind a feature flag and default off for 1h after rollout. Add an info link in the banner that points to the compaction dashboard. Also allow ops to "show raw" which bypasses dedupe.
Felix Müller: Implementation notes: claim_nonce should be cryptographically random (128-bit hex) so we can prove ordering. Logs should include claim_nonce and accept_ts. Reconciler should prefer winner_nonce by earliest accept_ts unless winner explicitly releases.
Jamal Ortiz: Billing compaction event schema draft: 
```
{
  "type":"billing_compaction",
  "tenant_id":"t_123",
  "resume_id":"rs_f7",
  "delta_seconds": -38,
  "winner_nonce":"0x9b3",
  "loser_nonce":"0x4d1",
  "orig_accept_ts":"2027-07-12T14:01:07Z"
}
```
Hannah Lee: We should make the compaction idempotent and include an audit_key to avoid double-applies. Also attach original token-batches so billing can unroll precisely.
Priya Nair: Rollout plan: ship claim_nonce logs + metric first (fast). Then deploy claim-broker worker (canary region eu-central) with feature flag. Console slow-mode behind flag (UX picks). Monitor stream.claim_fence_conflict rate and billing_compaction_emitted.
deploy-bot: Canary plan queued: claim-nonce logs -> eu-central in 10m; claim-broker worker -> eu-central in 40m; console flag rollout after backend validation.
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-10101: "streaming: claim-broker + billing compaction + console slow-mode (45s)" assigned to Hannah. ETA 5d.
Felix Müller: Follow-ups: 1) PR for claim-broker worker + compaction event (Felix) 2) claim_nonce logging + metric (Jamal) 3) console slow-mode flag + banner (Priya) 4) compaction dashboard + alert tuning (Hannah) 5) emergency admin-evict API for operator corrections.
Jamal Ortiz: Admin-evict API idea: POST /admin/resume/{resume_id}/evict?force=true&dry_run=true returns the compaction delta and preview. Must be audited.
Hannah Lee: I'll add a reconciler dashboard with time-to-compaction histogram and a panel for outstanding reconcile tickets. We'll mute billing alerts for affected windows by default and only unmute when compaction has been applied or after 2h.
Priya Nair: UX small detail: include a link to the admin-evict endpoint in the banner docs so SREs know how to force a correction in emergencies.
Jamal Ortiz: OK let's ship the telemetry/logging first and gate the claim-broker behind the feature flag. We'll monitor canary for claim_fence_conflict spikes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
